key_findings: ANP-230 blocks human Nav1.7, Nav1.8 and Nav1.9 with similar potency, with low activity on cardiac Nav1.5 and central Nav channels.
It acts as a tonic blocker without state- or use-dependence and causes a depolarizing shift of activation.
